steps: Cut deep slashes to the bone on both sides of the fish, every three centimetres.
Grind the garlic, ginger, chilli, stock cube, lemon juice and oil into a paste and work it into the cuts.
Leave the fish to marinate for an hour in the cold.
Slice the onions and sweat them in oil over a low heat for thirty minutes, to a caramel colour.
Stir the mustard and lemon juice into the onions and season; that is the yet sauce.
Grill the fish over indirect heat, twenty minutes a side.
Fry the plantain and serve the fish under the onion sauce, with the plantain and lemon.
